description: This file defines the CounterGrain class, which implements the ICounterGrain interface for distributed counter reporting in an Orleans-based system. It manages a list of grains with counters, provides methods to get total counter values, report durations, and wait times for reporting.

classes.name: CounterGrain
classes.description: A grain class that tracks other grains with counters and provides reporting functionalities.

methods.name: GetRunDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration for which the grain has been running, based on configuration options.

methods.name: GetTotalCounterValue
methods.description: Aggregates and returns the total counter value across all tracked grains for a given counter name.

methods.name: Track
methods.description: Adds a grain with counters to the tracking list.

methods.name: WaitTimeForReport
methods.description: Calculates and returns the remaining time until the next report based on configured report time.
